notes:
An update, ready when you are. A small download badge appears in the Home header only when a newer private release is available. Tap it to reopen the release details if you dismissed them.

A softer update page. Pastel light and dark styling, a clear version header, readable release-note cards and real download progress.

The same safety checks. Downloads still need the expected size, SHA-256, app identity, newer version and the same signing certificate before opening Android’s installer. Android still asks you to confirm Install.
